interruptedBody: The connection to the AI dropped before it finished. Nothing was changed.
cancelledBody: Stopped before it finished. Nothing was changed.
dockReady: {count, plural, one {# result ready} other {# results ready}}

privacy.accessOnBody: Below: what you've asked it lately, what happens to a request on its way, and who gets to see any of it.
privacy.accessOff: AI is not switched on for you
privacy.accessOffBody: Your role doesn't include AI use, so the AI buttons stay hidden and no run can start. An admin can grant it under Roles in the admin area.
privacy.encBody: The answer, and the record of what was sent to get it, are encrypted by our API server (AES-256-GCM) the moment they come back. The key never leaves that server, so the intranet's database only ever holds scrambled text — a leaked backup or anyone reading the tables sees no AI content.
privacy.encDeleted: Deleted, not just hidden, 30 days after the run started — or sooner, if you delete it from your history.
privacy.encSample: The customer asked about charging power — mention the wallbox's 11 kW and offer an on-site visit.
privacy.flowYouBody: Nothing runs on its own — a feature only sends anything when you ask it to.
privacy.flowApiBody: Gathers only what that task needs, read with your own access — the list further down says what each feature sends. Nothing else about you goes along.
privacy.flowModelBody: The request goes to Anthropic's API and Claude answers that one request. No other AI provider is involved.
privacy.managersNeverBody: Never what was sent or answered — that stays encrypted and yours.
privacy.moreLead: The same ground, in legal wording:
privacy.featuresHint: Every place in the intranet that can start an AI run, and what each one sends.

feature.wikiChat: Your question and the rest of that conversation, plus the wiki entries that best match your question — it cites them, so you can check where an answer came from. It doesn't read tickets, absences or anyone's records.
feature.wikiFormat: The wiki entry you're editing, to propose a tidier version of it.
feature.wikiMeta: The wiki entry you're editing, to suggest a title and tags for it.
feature.coachReport: The transcript of the call you just recorded in Sales Coach.
feature.coachEod: Your own Sales Coach calls from that day, for the daily summary.
feature.coachWikiExtract: The document you upload when importing one into the wiki.
feature.cvExtract: The CV file you upload to an applicant.
feature.cvRescan: That applicant's CV again, when you ask for an update.
feature.ask: The record you're asking about — an IT ticket with its history and thread, an announcement, an error report with its measures, a suggestion, or an applicant's profile and notes. The panel lists exactly what was included.
feature.dailyBrief: The same things your overview page shows you — your open tickets and measures, today's and tomorrow's events, unread announcements and how many chat messages are waiting (not their content) — to write a few sentences about your day.
feature.navigate: What you type into the helper, the pages you can open and your newest IT tickets. To find something specific it searches wiki entries, colleagues, announcements, suggestions, error reports, events and your tickets — only what you could open yourself — and sees the titles of what matched, not the content. Your AI history lists every search it made.

privacy.whoHint: An AI run belongs to whoever started it — and only they can read it, stop it or delete it.
privacy.youSeeBody: Your own runs in full — on the page that started them, in the AI dock, and in your history with the whole conversation.
privacy.managersSeeBody: How many runs there were, what failed and why, and how many tokens they used.
privacy.ratingsBody: If you rate an answer, your name, your note and which feature it was are visible to managers.
privacy.stopBody: Stop a run while it's working. Stopping changes nothing.
privacy.reviewBody: Nothing applies itself — suggested text is only saved once you accept it.
privacy.howTitle: What happens when you use it
privacy.howHint: The whole path of one request, and what's left of it afterwards.
privacy.deleteBody: Delete any run from its page; its answer and conversation go with it.

history.notFoundHint: Runs are deleted 30 days after they started, or when you delete them yourself.

history.truncated: This transcript was very long, so some passages are shortened here. The model received them in full.
